parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance whose public IP address you want to convert into an EIP.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs convert-nat-public-ip-to-eip --instance-id i-bp171jr36ge2ulvk0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
